question: Related Questions Q. Islamic baby Boy Name 7049 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum, Dear Brother, My name is Naseer and I am working in Dubai. I am sending this question on behalf of my friend. His third son name is Muhammed Subhan and his age is 2 years. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. Because it is not good to naming for a muslim child as Muhammed Subhan. We would like to know the answer for this uestion from your end. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 6711 Country: India Title: My nephew name is ravish, is it islamically permitted? Question: My nephew name is ravish, is it islamically permitted? Answer ID: 6711 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1231/1186=D/1429) Ravish means: method and pattern. There is no wrong in naming by the same, but not better for boy?s name. You should choose any better name, especially from the names of prophets, sahaba and pious people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
